title: Coverage Share on Repeat Claims and Coverage Out of Good Standing
content:
# Tariff Rider: The Coverage Share on Repeat Claims and Coverage Out of Good Standing

This rider fixes the share a protection coverage carries of the measured bench labour on a work order of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service. It is read from the coverage held on the piece in the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans records: how that coverage stands, how many claims have already been settled against it, and whether an inspection has ever been logged against the covered piece.

| What the coverage records show | The share the coverage carries |
|---|---|
| The coverage stands in force and a claim has already been settled against it | the repeat-claim share, 70 percent |
| The coverage stands out of good standing for a missed inspection and an inspection has at some time been logged against the covered piece | the reduced share for coverage out of good standing, 45 percent |
| Any other case | the share is not stepped down on either of these grounds |

## The rider in words

1. Where the coverage stands in force and a claim has already been settled against it, the share the coverage carries is the repeat-claim share of 70 percent.
2. Where the coverage stands out of good standing for a missed inspection and an inspection has at some time been logged against the covered piece, the share is the reduced share for coverage out of good standing, 45 percent.
3. In any other case the share is not stepped down on either of these grounds.

Both conditions in the first two clauses are compound: the standing of the coverage and, with it, the settled claim in the first, the logged inspection in the second. A coverage in force against which no claim has ever been settled falls outside clause 1. A coverage out of good standing for a missed inspection against which no inspection has ever been logged falls outside clause 2.

## Both sides of each condition

| The coverage records show | Clause engaged |
|---|---|
| In force, 2 claims settled | clause 1, share 70 percent |
| In force, no claim settled | clause 3 |
| Out of good standing for a missed inspection, 1 inspection logged | clause 2, share 45 percent |
| Out of good standing for a missed inspection, no inspection ever logged | clause 3 |
| Out of good standing for a missed inspection, 3 claims settled, no inspection logged | clause 3 |
